newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Friday shares seen mixed on U.S. news.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Friday shares seen mixed on U.S. news.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen mixed on Friday as the market continued to digest Wall Street's Wednesday plunge and prepared for a speech due to be given in the U.S. by Fed chairman Alan Greenspan, dealers said.
"At the beginning of the week the market lifted on U.S. news and softened later on more news, but there's been no direct correlation with Wall Street," one dealer at a local firm said.
"I'm wondering if we've not already begun to discount what Greenspan might have to say," said another.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index closed down 8.75 points at 2,059.38 on Thursday.
